privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: PRIVACY POLICY FOR MEMOPAL
privacy.responsibleValue: the owners of the MemoPal platform

section1.title: 1. Information We Collect
section1.intro: At MemoPal, we are committed to minimizing data collection and only process information strictly necessary to provide the spaced repetition service. Our platform is designed for high school students, college students (technical, technological, and university degrees), and professionals from various fields who wish to organize and review their study materials.

jwt.title: 1.1. JWT Token (Authentication)
purposeItems: User authentication and essential technical operation of the application
jwt.legalBasisValue: Contract execution (Law 1581 of 2012). Necessary for the requested service.

registration.title: 1.2. Registration Data
purposeItems: Send verification emails and essential service communications
registration.legalBasisValue: Explicit user consent or contract execution

usage.title: 1.3. Usage Data
purposeItems: Provide the main spaced repetition functionality

googleCalendar.title: 1.4. Google Calendar Tokens
whatWeCollectItems: Google Access Token and Refresh Token, stored securely
purposeItems: Integration with Google Calendar to create scheduled study events

emailVerification.title: 1.5. Email Verification Token
whatWeCollectItems: Temporary token that expires in 24 hours
purposeItems: Verify the authenticity of the user's email address
emailVerification.legalBasisValue: Technical and security necessity of the service

images.title: 1.6. Images in Study Cards
whatWeCollectItems: Images stored in Cloudflare R2 CDN, optimized with Sharp
purposeItems: Allow the user to add visual content to their study materials

ai.title: 1.7. Use of Artificial Intelligence
ai.intro: MemoPal may use third-party artificial intelligence services to enhance the user's study experience, including features such as:
features: Analysis of educational documents uploaded by the user
Automatic generation of study cards based on provided content
Creation of summaries and personalized notes according to student parameters
importantItems: The user uploads documents VOLUNTARILY for these features
Documents are temporarily sent to the AI provider's servers for processing
Content is processed ONLY to generate the result requested by the user
The AI providers used do NOT use user content to train their models
Original documents are NOT permanently stored in third-party services
Only the generated content (cards, notes, summaries) is saved in the user's MemoPal account
ai.servicesTitle: AI services that may be used:
servicesItems: Google Gemini API: For natural language processing and educational content analysis
ai.userControl: The user maintains full control over which documents are processed with AI and can choose NOT to use these features at any time.

clarification.title: IMPORTANT CLARIFICATION
clarification.intro: Our application does NOT proactively collect:
items: Full IP address
Detailed device information
Precise location data (GPS)
Analytics, marketing, or third-party cookies
Browsing data beyond what is strictly necessary

technicalCookies.title: TECHNICAL COOKIES
items: httpOnly cookie with JWT token (expiration: 48 hours)
Configuration: secure in production, sameSite='lax'
Exclusive purpose: session authentication

section2.title: 2. Purpose and Legal Basis for Processing
section2.intro: We use your data exclusively for:

mainServices.title: 2.1. Main Services
items: Provide and maintain the spaced repetition service with adaptive algorithm
Manage your user account and secure authentication
Allow you to access your study history, progress, and statistics
Implement the streak system to motivate consistent study
Manage study topics with customizable colors
Store and display study cards (flashcard or explanation type)

communications.title: 2.2. Essential Communications
items: Send verification email upon registration (using Resend API)
Notifications related to your account security
Necessary communications about service changes

integrations.title: 2.3. Optional Integrations
items: Synchronization with Google Calendar (only if you explicitly authorize)
Automatic creation of study events in your calendar
Reminders for scheduled sessions (15 and 5 minutes before)

section2.legalBasis: The legal basis for this processing is the necessity for the EXECUTION OF THE CONTRACT for service provision that you request when using our application, in accordance with Law 1581 of 2012 and other Colombian data protection regulations.

infrastructure.title: 3.1. Infrastructure
items: Database: PostgreSQL hosted on Railway
Image storage: Cloudflare R2 CDN
Backend server: Railway (https://memopalapi-production.up.railway.app)
Frontend: Cloudflare Pages (https://memopal.app)

security.title: 3.2. Implemented Security Measures
items: Passwords encrypted with bcrypt (cost factor: 9)
JWT tokens with 48-hour expiration
HTTPS encrypted connections in all communications
httpOnly and secure cookies in production
Google Calendar tokens with automatic renewal
Ownership validation in all operations (users only access their own resources)
Authentication middleware on all protected routes
Optimized database indexes to prevent unauthorized access
Cascade deletion of related data to ensure integrity

imageOptimization.title: 3.3. Image Optimization
items: All uploaded images are automatically optimized with Sharp
Maximum resizing: 1200x1200 pixels
Output format: JPEG with 85% quality
Storage in Cloudflare R2 CDN for fast and secure delivery

section4.title: 4. Third-Party Services We Use
section4.intro: To provide our service, we share minimal and necessary data with the following providers:

railway.title: 4.1. Railway (Hosting)
railway.dataShared: Data shared: All information stored in our database (necessary for technical operation)
railway.purpose: Purpose: PostgreSQL database and backend server hosting

cloudflareR2.title: 4.2. Cloudflare R2 (CDN Storage)
cloudflareR2.dataShared: Data shared: Images uploaded by the user in study cards
cloudflareR2.purpose: Purpose: Multimedia content storage and distribution

cloudflarePages.title: 4.3. Cloudflare Pages (Frontend Hosting)
cloudflarePages.dataShared: Data shared: No personal data; only static web application files
cloudflarePages.purpose: Purpose: Hosting and distribution of the user web interface

gemini.title: 4.5. Google Gemini API (Artificial Intelligence)
gemini.dataShared: Data shared: Documents that the user voluntarily uploads for AI processing
gemini.purpose: Purpose: Natural language processing, document analysis, and personalized educational content generation
gemini.usage: Usage: Voluntary - only when the user activates AI features

googleCalendar.title: 4.6. Google Calendar API (Optional Integration)
googleCalendar.dataShared: Data shared: OAuth 2.0 tokens (Access Token and Refresh Token)
googleCalendar.purpose: Purpose: Automatic creation of study events in the user's calendar
googleCalendar.usage: Usage: Completely OPTIONAL - requires explicit user authorization
details: Automatic creation of study events according to spaced repetition algorithm
Events are created for the next day at 9:00 AM by default
Automatic reminders: 15 minutes and 5 minutes before the event
Event color: Blue (#4) for easy visual identification
Smart management: automatic update if review date changes
Automatic deletion if the card set is deleted
User can disconnect the integration at any time from settings
googleCalendar.important: IMPORTANT: We do not store Google credentials. We only save the OAuth tokens necessary for synchronization, which are automatically renewed and can be revoked by the user at any time.

activeUse.title: 5.1. During Active Service Use
activeUse.content: While your account is active, we will retain your data indefinitely to provide the service.

deletion.title: 5.2. After Account Deletion Request
items: Personal data will be permanently deleted within a maximum of 30 days
The deletion process includes:
- Deletion of all records in the database (PostgreSQL)
- Deletion of all images stored in Cloudflare R2
- Deletion of all events created in Google Calendar (if integration was active)
- Revocation of all authentication and session tokens

autoExpiration.title: 5.3. Data with Automatic Expiration
items: JWT tokens: Automatic expiration at 48 hours
Email verification tokens: Automatic expiration at 24 hours
Google Calendar tokens: Automatic renewal; revoked when account is deleted

section6.title: 6. Your Rights as Data Subject
section6.intro: In accordance with Law 1581 of 2012 and Decree 1377 of 2013, you have the following rights:

access.title: 6.1. Right of Access
access.content: Know, update, and rectify your personal data stored on our platform. You can access all your information from your account settings.

update.title: 6.2. Right of Update and Rectification
update.content: Modify your personal data at any time from your account settings.

items: Your user account
All created study topics and cards
All review history and statistics
All stored images

revocation.intro: You can revoke the consent granted for the processing of your data at any time through:
items: Deletion of your account from settings
Disconnection of optional integrations (Google Calendar)
Contact us at support@memopal.app

complaints.title: 6.5. Filing Complaints
complaints.content: If you believe your rights have been violated, you can file a complaint with the Superintendence of Industry and Commerce (SIC) of Colombia.

section7.intro: Our service is aimed at high school students, college students, and professionals.

section7.parentalConsent: For users under 14 years of age, we require consent from a parent or legal guardian. Parents or guardians can contact us at support@memopal.app to manage minor accounts.

notificationMethods: Email to the address registered in your account

section2.description: MemoPal is a digital spaced repetition platform designed for high school students, college students (technical, technological, and university degrees), and professionals from various fields that allows creating, organizing, and reviewing study materials using adaptive spaced repetition algorithms.

featureA.title: A. Content Management
items: Creation and editing of digital study cards with two types: FLASHCARD (Question and answer cards) and EXPLANATION (Explanatory note cards)
Organization by study topics with customizable colors
Support for multiple images per card (maximum 5MB per image)
Automatic image optimization (resizing to 1200x1200px, JPEG 85% compression)
Advanced search for cards and topics

featureB.title: B. Spaced Repetition System
items: Adaptive algorithm based on card difficulty

Automatic scheduling of reviews according to optimal intervals: First review (1, 3, or 7 days depending on difficulty), Subsequent reviews (dynamically adjusted intervals), Maximum interval (30 days for easy cards)
Difficulty rating in three levels (1=Easy, 2=Medium, 3=Hard)

featureC.title: C. Tracking and Statistics
items: Complete history of completed reviews
Dashboard with academic progress metrics: Total topics and cards, Pending and completed reviews, Current streak and longest streak, Daily activity
Streak system to motivate consistent study
Statistics per individual card

featureD.title: D. Google Calendar Integration (Optional)
items: Automatic creation of events for study sessions
Bidirectional synchronization with Google Calendar
Automatic reminders (15 and 5 minutes before)
Smart event management: Creation when adding new cards, Update when completing reviews, Deletion when removing content

featureE.title: E. Security and Account Features
items: JWT authentication with 48-hour tokens
Mandatory email verification
Passwords encrypted with bcrypt
Password management (change and recovery)
Multi-language support (Spanish and English)
Custom timezone configuration

featureF.title: F. Storage and Synchronization
items: Secure storage of study history in PostgreSQL
Cloudflare R2 CDN for fast image delivery
Optimized pagination in all lists
Database indexes for optimal performance
